deals.title: AMD Token Lab (free dev credits)
deals.dates: 30 days from key creation (your exact expiry unknown) · one 15-day extension in the last 5 days (secondary sources)
deals.detail: 10 Token Lab points for members of the free AMD AI Developer Program (global, no card). OpenAI-compatible API at https://api.tokenlab.amd.com/v1. Best model there: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (same weights as your fleet, $0 while points last vs River $0.323 paid). Also: Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-4-31B-IT, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, three MiniCPM models, and decision models d3, d3-flash and Clef. AMD's official cloud-credit page also names GLM-5.3 among Token Lab models (not in a 13 Nov firsthand 10-model catalog). No Qwen4 / Qwen4 Max / Qwen4-Max-Preview. Hermes measured 1 request at a time (429 model_concurrency_rate_limit_exceeded); secondary sources also quote 20 requests/min, which is not on official AMD pages. GET /v1/models requires a key (401 without one). Program end date not announced; requests fail when points or the 30 days run out.
